verdict.rationale: Azure's first-party Terraform documentation lists 'Export resources to HCL code', which is a documented way to bring existing Azure resources under IaC rather than only building greenfield. The evidence is a single heading-level mention with no workflow detail. Nothing in the pack covers drift detection or reconciliation for Bicep, ARM or Terraform. missing for 10: documented drift-detection workflow, depth on the export/import process (scope, limitations, state import), Bicep/ARM equivalents for existing resources, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a platform engineer, existing resources can come under IaC — documented import/drift workflows instead of a greenfield-only story
